svg.title: Figure 1: System overview of the smart-meter pipeline and its verification
svg.desc: HKUST workbooks and Brick metadata are audited into a canonical Parquet and NDJSON snapshot. The snapshot feeds a Kafka, Spark, Bronze, Silver, Gold delivery path and an independent HDFS, Hadoop Streaming reference path. Gold and Hadoop outputs are reconciled; a match gives a verified result and a dashboard, a mismatch or incomplete replay blocks publication.
